SQL_Text: ALTER proc [dbo].[USP_Sch_GetPendingKRSID]   as   begin          select  distinct top 1000    k.KRS_Id,KRS_MStsId,SchTRN_NoOfAttempt from KRS k with (nolock)    left join BBMp_Easthi_Schedular_Trn t with (nolock)   on k.KRS_Id = t.SchTRN_krs_id   and t.SchTRN_NoOfAttempt <10   and isnull(t.SchTRN_StatusId,0)=99 and t.SchTRN_sch_id=1    left join KRS_PropDetailsAsPerDeed d on k.KRS_Id=d.PDAD_KRS_ID   where    k.KRS_MStsId >=8 and KRS_Active=1   and isnull(k.KRS_EasthiSts_Id,0) not in (10,100) and isnull(t.SchTRN_NoOfAttempt,0) <10   and KRS_Id in ( (select KRS_Id from krs where KRS_MPT_ID in (1,2,3)   and KRS_MStsId in (8,10,14,11)))       and LEN(KRS_SASNo)=10  	 and len(KRS_EPID)=10  	 and isnull(KRS_EPID,'') <>'Cannot Generate EPID.Please Contact EAASTHI' 	 and isnull(PDAD_IsDeedBeforeOrAfter2004,'after') in  	 ( 	 'before', 'Notification', 'DevAprBDA', 'after', 	 'NoDeed', 'sarfaesi' 	 ) 	 	and KRS_Id not in (186230) 	 	  and  (isnull(KRS_IsSSA_applied,0)=0 or isnull(KRS_IsSSA_applied,0)=2 or  isnull(KRS_IsSSA_applied,0)=10 ) 	and KRS_EPID in ( '3458432602' )    order by KRS_Id asc   end

/*=========================================================           STEP 0 : DROP TEMP TABLES         =========================================================*/          DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Apps;         DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #JCMovedDate;           /*=========================================================           STEP 1 : GET BASE ELIGIBLE APPLICATIONS         =========================================================*/          SELECT             a.App_Id,             a.App_DisplayId,             a.App_Status,             a.GBA,             a.GBAId,             a.App_MotherEPID,             a.App_Source,              ofi.BtoA_RoadId,             ofi.BtoA_RoadName,              ksr.Road_ID,             ksr.Road_Name,             ksr.GuidanceValueSqMt,              /* EPID Metadata */             b.MD_Zonename,             b.MD_WardName,             b.MD_SiteArea,             b.MD_ZoneId,             b.MD_WardId,             b.MD_StreetId,              /* Officer Details */             o.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty,             o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue,             o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId,             o.Ofcr_RoadFacingSides,             o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType          INTO #Apps          FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp a          INNER JOIN dbo.BtoA_EPIDMetaData b             ON b.MD_APP_ID = a.App_Id          INNER JOIN         (             SELECT                 Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId,                 Ofcr_IsGovtProperty,                 Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue,                 Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId,                 Ofcr_RoadFacingSides,                 ResidentialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt,                 CommercialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt,                 IndustrialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt,                 KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType             FROM dbo.BtoA_MainApp_Officer         ) o             ON o.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id          INNER JOIN dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer ofi             ON ofi.BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id          INNER JOIN masterDB_prod.dbo.MstRoadKSRAC ksr             ON ofi.BtoA_RoadId = ksr.Road_ID          /* JC Officer eligibility */         INNER JOIN masterDB_prod.dbo.mst_officer ofc             ON b.MD_ZoneId = ofc.Ofcr_ZoneId          WHERE             a.App_Active = 1             AND a.App_Status in (14,1000)             AND ofc.Ofcr_RoleId = 125             AND ofc.Ofcr_Active = 1             AND a.App_Source = 'newkhata'             AND b.MD_SiteArea >= 50             AND b.MD_SiteArea <= 1000             AND ISNULL(ofi.IsRMPPropersed, 'N') = 'N'             AND ksr.GuidanceValueSqMt IS NOT NULL 			AND a.App_JCMovedDate is not null             AND a.App_JCMovedDate < DATEADD(DAY, -13, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))             AND ofc.Ofcr_Id NOT IN (65, 11240, 11241) 			AND ISNULL(a.IsApp_MasterPlanMismatch, 0) = 0             AND ISNULL(a.IsApp_PropertyVerificationRequired, 0) = 0          /*=========================================================           ROAD-WIDENING AREA VALIDATION         =========================================================*/          AND         (             /* Commercial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 1                 AND ISNULL(o.CommercialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )              OR              /* Residential */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 2                 AND ISNULL(o.ResidentialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )              OR              /* Mixed - BOTH areas must be greater than 5 */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 3                 AND ISNULL(o.CommercialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5                 AND ISNULL(o.ResidentialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )              OR              /* Industrial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 4                 AND ISNULL(o.IndustrialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )         )          /*=========================================================           PROPERTY USE TYPE VS MASTER PLAN VALIDATION         =========================================================*/          AND         (             /* Residential -> ONLY Residential */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Residential'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType = 'Residential'             )              OR              /* Commercial -> Residential OR Commercial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Commercial'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN                     ('Residential', 'Commercial')             )              OR              /* Industrial -> Residential OR Industrial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Industrial'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN                     ('Residential', 'Industrial')             )              OR              /* Mixed -> Residential OR Commercial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Mixed'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN                     ('Residential', 'Commercial')             )         );           /*=========================================================           INDEX TEMP TABLE         =========================================================*/          CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Apps_AppId         ON #Apps(App_Id);           /*=========================================================           STEP 2 : GET LATEST JC MOVED DATE         =========================================================*/          SELECT             s.Sts_MainAppId AS App_Id,             MAX(s.Udt) AS App_JCMovedDate          INTO #JCMovedDate          FROM dbo.BtoA_Status_Master_Tran s          INNER JOIN #Apps a             ON a.App_Id = s.Sts_MainAppId          WHERE             s.Sts_MainAppStatus in (14,1000)          GROUP BY             s.Sts_MainAppId          HAVING             MAX(s.Udt) < DATEADD(DAY, -13, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE));           /*=========================================================           INDEX JC TEMP TABLE         =========================================================*/          CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_JCMovedDate_AppId         ON #JCMovedDate(App_Id);           /*=========================================================           STEP 3 : INSERT ONLY NEW ELIGIBLE APPLICATIONS            ApplicationDisplayID already existing in target table           will NOT be inserted.         =========================================================*/          INSERT INTO dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications         (             ApplicationDisplayID,             MotherEPID,             Application_Status,             Corporation,             Zone,             Ward,             IsGovtProperty,             BtoA_RoadId,             BtoA_RoadName,             Road_ID,             Road_Name,             GuidanceValueSqMt,             PropertyUseType,             Application_JCMovedDate,             Application_type,             BtoA_RoadType,             IsMasterPlanMismatch,             SiteArea,             JC_Pending_Days,             CreatedDate,             OfficerName,             IsAutoApprovedManually         )          SELECT DISTINCT              a.App_DisplayId AS ApplicationDisplayID,              a.App_MotherEPID AS MotherEPID,              CASE                 WHEN a.App_Status  in (14,1000)                 THEN 'Pending with JC'                 ELSE ''             END AS Application_Status,              a.GBA AS Corporation,              a.MD_Zonename AS Zone,              a.MD_WardName AS Ward,              CASE                 WHEN ISNULL(a.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty, 0) = 0                 THEN 'NO'             END AS IsGovtProperty,              a.BtoA_RoadId,              a.BtoA_RoadName,              a.Road_ID,              a.Road_Name,              a.GuidanceValueSqMt,              a.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue AS PropertyUseType,              jc.App_JCMovedDate AS Application_JCMovedDate,              CASE                 WHEN a.App_Source <> 'newkhata'                 THEN 'B2A'             END AS Application_type,              'public' AS BtoA_RoadType,              'No' AS IsMasterPlanMismatch,              a.MD_SiteArea AS SiteArea,              DATEDIFF             (                 DAY,                 CAST(jc.App_JCMovedDate AS DATE),                 CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)             ) AS JC_Pending_Days,              GETDATE() AS CreatedDate,              jcOfficer.Ofcr_Name AS OfficerName,              0 AS IsAutoApprovedManually          FROM #Apps a          INNER JOIN #JCMovedDate jc             ON jc.App_Id = a.App_Id           /*=========================================================           GET ONE ACTIVE JC OFFICER FOR THE ZONE         =========================================================*/          OUTER APPLY         (             SELECT TOP 1                 ofc.Ofcr_Name,                 ofc.Ofcr_Id              FROM masterDB_prod.dbo.mst_officer ofc              WHERE                 ofc.Ofcr_ZoneId = a.MD_ZoneId                 AND ofc.Ofcr_RoleId = 125                 AND ofc.Ofcr_Active = 1                 AND ofc.Ofcr_Id NOT IN (65, 11240, 11241)              ORDER BY                 ofc.Ofcr_Id          ) jcOfficer           WHERE          /*=========================================================           1. MUST HAVE AT LEAST ONE ROAD         =========================================================*/          EXISTS         (             SELECT 1              FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer r              WHERE r.BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id         )           /*=========================================================           2. ALL ROADS MUST BE PUBLIC         =========================================================*/          AND NOT EXISTS         (             SELECT 1              FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer r              WHERE r.BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id              AND             (                 r.BtoA_RoadType IS NULL                 OR LTRIM(RTRIM(r.BtoA_RoadType)) = ''                 OR LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(r.BtoA_RoadType))) <> 'public'             )         )           /*=========================================================           3. EVERY ROAD MUST MATCH KSRAC         =========================================================*/          AND NOT EXISTS         (             SELECT 1              FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer r              WHERE r.BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id              AND NOT EXISTS             (                 SELECT 1                  FROM masterDB_prod.dbo.mst_AROMapping aro                  INNER JOIN masterDB_prod.dbo.MstRoadKSRAC k                     ON k.GBAZONEID = aro.GBAZONEID                     AND k.BBMPWardId = aro.BBMPWardId                     AND k.Road_Active = 1                  WHERE                     aro.GBAZONEID = a.MD_ZoneId                     AND aro.BBMPWardId = a.MD_WardId                     AND aro.BBMPStreetId = a.MD_StreetId                     AND aro.easthiULBNAME_CorpId = a.GBAId                     AND k.GuidanceValueSqMt IS NOT NULL                     AND k.Road_ID = r.BtoA_RoadId                     AND LTRIM(RTRIM(k.Road_Name))                         = LTRIM(RTRIM(r.BtoA_RoadName))             )         )           /*=========================================================           4. EXCLUDE GOVERNMENT PROPERTY         =========================================================*/          AND ISNULL(a.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty, 0) = 0           /*=========================================================           5. EXCLUDE GOOGLE GOVERNMENT PROPERTY         =========================================================*/          AND NOT EXISTS         (             SELECT 1              FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteDtls s              WHERE s.Site_App_Id = a.App_Id              AND ISNULL(s.GooglePropertyType, '') = 'govt'         )           /*=========================================================           PREVENT DUPLICATE INSERTS         =========================================================*/          AND NOT EXISTS         (             SELECT 1             FROM dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications j              WHERE j.ApplicationDisplayID = a.App_DisplayId               AND ISNULL(j.MotherEPID, '') = ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '')         );           /*=========================================================           STEP 4 : UPDATE STATUS TRANSACTION            FINAL UPDATE 2            Source applications are identified ONLY from           JC_Auto_Approved_B2A_Applications         =========================================================*/          UPDATE s         SET             s.Sts_PrevStatusId = s.Sts_MainAppStatus,             s.Sts_MainAppStatus = 150,             s.Sts_CurrStatusId = 150,             s.Udt = GETDATE(),             s.Sts_comments = 'The application is auto-approved in JC Login',             s.Sts_PrevOfficerRoleId = s.Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId,             s.Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId = 125,             s.Sts_PrevOfficerId = s.Sts_CurrOfficerId          FROM dbo.BtoA_Status_Master_Tran s          INNER JOIN dbo.BtoAMainApp a             ON a.App_Id = s.Sts_MainAppId          INNER JOIN dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications b             ON b.ApplicationDisplayID = a.App_DisplayId             AND ISNULL(b.MotherEPID, '') = ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '')          WHERE             s.Sts_MainAppStatus in (14,1000) and a.App_Status in (14,1000)  and a.App_Source='newkhata' 			and isnull(a.IsApp_PropertyVerificationRequired,0)=0 and isnull(a.IsApp_MasterPlanMismatch,0)=0;     --      /*=========================================================   --        STEP 5 : UPDATE MAIN APPLICATION    --        FINAL UPDATE 3    --        Source applications are identified ONLY from   --        JC_Auto_Approved_B2A_Applications   --      =========================================================*/          UPDATE a         SET             a.IsApp_JCAutoApproved = 1,             a.App_JCApprovedDate = GETDATE(),             a.App_AdditionalInfo =  'The application is auto-approved in JC Login',             a.App_Status = 150,             a.App_UDte = GETDATE()          FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp a          INNER JOIN dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications b             ON b.ApplicationDisplayID = a.App_DisplayId             AND ISNULL(b.MotherEPID, '') =                 ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '')          WHERE a.App_Status in (14,1000) and a.App_Source='newkhata' 		and isnull(a.IsApp_PropertyVerificationRequired,0)=0 and isnull(a.IsApp_MasterPlanMismatch,0)=0;     --      /*=========================================================   --        STEP 6 : UPDATE TARGET TABLE    --        FINAL UPDATE 1    --        Update only records available in   --        JC_Auto_Approved_B2A_Applications   --      =========================================================*/  		UPDATE b 		SET  		    b.IsAutoApprovedManually = 1 		FROM dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications b 		INNER JOIN dbo.BtoAMainApp a 		    ON a.App_DisplayId = b.ApplicationDisplayID 		    AND ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '') = ISNULL(b.MotherEPID, '') 		WHERE  		ISNULL(b.IsAutoApprovedManually, 0) = 0 		AND b.CreatedDate >= CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) 		AND b.CreatedDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) 		AND a.App_Status = 150 		AND ISNULL(a.IsApp_JCAutoApproved, 0) = 1 and  		isnull(a.IsApp_PropertyVerificationRequired,0)=0 and isnull(a.IsApp_MasterPlanMismatch,0)=0;          /*=========================================================           CLEANUP         =========================================================*/          DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #JCMovedDate;         DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Apps;           COMMIT TRANSACTION;      END TRY      BEGIN CATCH          IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0             ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;          DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000);         DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT;         DECLARE @ErrorState INT;          SELECT             @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(),             @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),             @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();          RAISERROR         (             @ErrorMessage,             @ErrorSeverity,             @ErrorState         );      END CATCH;  	SELECT     a.App_Id,     a.App_DisplayId AS ApplicationDisplayID,     a.App_MotherEPID AS MotherEPID,     a.App_Status,     a.IsApp_JCAutoApproved,     a.App_JCApprovedDate,     a.App_UDte,     a.App_AdditionalInfo,     b.CreatedDate AS AutoApprovalCreatedDate,     b.IsAutoApprovedManually 	FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp a 	INNER JOIN dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications b 	    ON a.App_DisplayId = b.ApplicationDisplayID 	    AND ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '') = ISNULL(b.MotherEPID, '') 	WHERE a.App_Status = 150 	  AND ISNULL(a.IsApp_JCAutoApproved, 0) = 1 	  AND b.CreatedDate >= CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) 	  AND b.CreatedDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) 	ORDER BY a.App_JCApprovedDate DESC;  END
